Tool

A soft playground for drawing with blobs on a grid, where nodes melt together into organic shapes. Draw, remix and add stickers, then save your artwork and share it with friends. Created for SOFTER, in the spirit of exploring technology and digital media as a space for creation, imagination and collaboration.

Instructions

  • Draw places nodes on the grid. Erase removes them. Symmetry mirrors your drawing left to right.
  • Remix creates a new design every click
  • Grid spacing and node size resizes your design. Shape, style and colours change the appearance.
  • Type text to turn it into nodes.
  • Save gives you a PNG image, or an SVG you can edit in Illustrator or Figma.

Created by Imogen Fox for SOFTER, a global feminist technology network.
